sources.title: Pengfei Sheng and colleagues: Human isotopic evidence from the Guanzhong Basin (2023)
sources.note: Direct full journal article, abstract, sampling, Results and Discussion read. Retains sampled-group limits; does not equate nitrogen with all nutritional health or infer affection from similar diet.

batchIdentityNotes.note: Exact historical index in data/civilizations-seams.json,557 to 581; no card/override or staged draft collision at claim. Topology search initially missed GeoJSON. Two china-seams.geojson features decoded:557 to 577 bbox95,26,112,40 and577 to 581 bbox110.5,32.2,126,42.5. Later shape excludes Chang’an/the western core. Public overview explicitly flags this; no substitute modern polygon. Preserve curated successors but existing fell text incorrectly calls deposed Emperor Jing Yang Jian’s grandson; recommend neutral replacement Yang Jian took the throne in581 and foundedSui, without unsupported kinship. Broad sixth-century diet and late-sixth ceramic explicitly include adjacent dynastic phases. No toilet claim made because no adequate NorthernZhou-specific household evidence checked.
